# Teams

- A user can create a team and becomes its owner.
- Owners and admins can invite members by email. Invites expire after 7 days.
- Owners and admins can remove members. TBD: can an admin remove another admin?
- Members see the team's projects.

files.docs/spec-search.md:
# Product search

- GET /products?q= returns products whose name contains q (case-insensitive), max 20 results.
- The products page has a search box that updates results as the user types (debounced 300 ms).
- Empty q returns the first 20 products.
